verdict: Meta leads are accelerating; Google spend needs conversion tracking fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Meta delivered all 15 tracked leads at a cost per lead of $169.75, and lead volume jumped 550% in the most recent week compared to the week prior — the momentum is real and confirmed by day-level data. Google Ads, meanwhile, absorbed $1,845 in spend over the same window but conversion tracking is not firing correctly, so the 7 conversions shown in the Google dashboard are unverified and cannot be counted as confirmed leads. We are repairing the Google conversion tracking now so that spend can be properly evaluated and budget allocation adjusted between channels. Separately, your CRM shows 66 opportunities created this period while tracked leads show 15 — source tagging is being reconciled so both numbers tell the same story going forward. Next period you should expect cleaner Google data and a clearer read on true cost per lead across all channels.

week-over-week increase in lead volume in the most recent 7 days
spent on Google Ads this period with conversion tracking currently unverified

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversion tracking is not recording results, leaving $1,845 in spend unaccountable.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired this week so Google results can be verified and budget decisions can be made on confirmed data.
